Work tables resembling globes were the usual form for a lady's sewing or writing table around 1800 in Austria. Combining moving parts, secret compartments, and highly finished decoration, these tables were also a way for the cabinetmaker to show off his skill. The tripod supports and temple-like architectural quality of both the exterior and interior decoration reflect the fashionable taste for neoclassical style, or Biedermeier as it was called in Austria, where Vienna was the center of such elaborate furniture production.

source_title: View of Second Spring Exhibition of the OBMOKhU. Bolshaia Dimitrovska, Moscow, 1921 - 1024x732
desc_src: View of Second Spring Exhibition of the OBMOKhU . Bolshaia Dimitrovska, Moscow, 1921. In 1921 the Constructivists expressed their ideas at an ambitious Moscow exhibition under the umbrella of the Society of Young Artists ( Общество молодых художников abbreviated to ОБМОХУ/OBMOKhU, OBMOChU ). Johannsons' nine three-dimensional space structures , "self-stressed constructions", exhibited innovative tension-integrity strain-stress principles of tensegrity .

Anamorfos (grek. anamorfosis, ombildning), vrängd eller vanskaplig bild, som är ritad på sådant sätt, att den ger riktiga bilder af föremålen, när den betraktas i en viss sned riktning (optisk anamorfos), i en cylindrisk, konisk eller pyramidalisk spegel (katoptrisk a.) eller genom mångkantiga slipade glas (dioptrisk a.). Zeiss i Jena har konstruerat ett linssystem, den s. k. anamorfoten, hvilken, använd som fotografiskt objektiv, möjliggör framställningen af inom önskade gränser förvridna bilder. Cast iron mechanical bank in the shape of a girl sitting on bench next to a large dog. To operate the bank, a coin is placed on the tray held in the girl's right hand. A lever on the floor is pressed causing the dog to open his mouth and wag his tail as the bench seat opens and the girl's arm tilts sliding the coin into the opening. Manufactured by the Shepard Hardware Company circa 1885. Title: Speaking Dog Mechanical Coin Bank
